<thought>The most intense peak is at m/z 121.0528, which in positive‑mode ESI likely corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈120.0455 Da. The formula that matches this mass best is C₄H₈O₄ (exact mass 120.0423 Da, within a few ppm). The observed M+1 and M+2 isotopic intensities are consistent with a molecule containing four carbons and four oxygens.</thought>
<final_answer>C4H8O4</final_answer>
